info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Analcime Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Analcime Drill Detail Catalog API facilitates the creation of detailed records for analcime drill information within the catalog system. This API enables users to efficiently add new entries that encompass essential characteristics and metadata related to analcime drilling activities. Typical consumers include geologists, data analysts, and operational teams who require precise drill data for project planning and reporting. By utilizing this service, organizations can maintain an organized and easily accessible repository of drill details, enhancing collaboration and decision-making processes.
